thread:
Nina Alvarez: Heads-up: short release-train bulletin. Two items: freeze reminder + canary status. Please skim and ack.

deploy-bot: Canary started for search-indexer v2.2 at 2026-04-02T10:05:00Z 4% traffic. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/3915001234-indexer-v2.2

Theo Park: Initial canary telemetry looks good. p50 unchanged, p95 +6ms, errors 0.05%. I'll keep an eye for 1h.

Nina Alvarez: Freeze window: Mon 2026-04-06 17:00 PT -> Thu 2026-04-09 09:00 PT. No standard prod deploys during that window. Exceptions: security hotfixes and rollback-only patches (approval required).

Emma Clarke: New note: exception approvals during freeze require both Eng Manager and SRE approval. Use the form and tag approvers. Form: https://forms.gle/freeze-req-2026

Ravi (sre): Infra note: autoscaler burst cap tweak rolling Friday. If you rely on burst scaling, please verify service configs or opt-out via ticket #burst-optout.

Theo Park: Observed a small memory creep on indexer-host-05 during ramp. Restarted container; no user impact. I'll open a follow-up if it recurs.

Nina Alvarez: Action items: 1) Service owners confirm any migrations won't be promoted during freeze (reply here). 2) Cancel/reschedule non-critical deploys. 3) Flag any cross-freeze migrations ASAP.

Emma Clarke: Quick Q: Are internal staging canaries allowed during freeze?

Nina Alvarez: Yes, staging/internal cluster canaries OK. No prod-facing canaries without exception.

deploy-bot: Summary posted and thread pinned in #eng-releases.

Nina Alvarez: Thanks all  please ack or raise blockers.
